text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle got injured, so I 
immediately brought her to the nurse's 
office.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to make you worry~ Looks like it 
wasn't a big deal after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we get back to training?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes. It doesn't hurt anymore, either.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course, I plan to do it while 
keeping a close eye on the condition. 
...Is that a problem?
choice_data_list: Let's play it safe and take a break.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told Hishi Miracle that we couldn't 
ignore the risk of her injury worsening.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
True, an injury is still an injury, no 
matter how minor. I don't want to take it 
lightly and end up regretting it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'll stay resting for a while.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... The place I hurt earlier is 
really starting to throb...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I thought it would be fine, but 
maybe I shouldn't have moved it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle's injury worsened, and she 
ended up having to take time off to 
rest...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. Just as I thought, it looks like 
it'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad it wasn't a serious injury. I'll 
keep doing my best at this rate~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle overcame her injury after 
that, and managed to make a very smooth 
recovery.
